findings.finding: The development Pareto supports a precision/IoU tradeoff, not an unqualified H5 win. H5 frozen point: document-macro IoU 0.594327, pooled recall 0.980097, pooled precision 0.246587 at texture/CNN thresholds 0.15/0.25. H2 matched base control's recorded precision-best point among recall >=0.98: 0.599290 / 0.980062 / 0.218765 at 0.17/0.23. H5 raises pooled precision by about 2.78 percentage points and has essentially the same recall, while its document-macro IoU is about 0.50 points lower. The two points optimize different criteria (H5 point maximizes macro IoU under the recall gate; H2 point maximizes precision under that gate), so say which selection objective is being compared.

The frozen v3 record is development-only and sets native_confirmation_pending=true. Its 55-query/12-document development point is not the full 57-query/13-document public-validation result. Keep document-macro IoU separate from mean query IoU and explicitly call precision and recall pooled/global; they have different denominators from document-macro IoU.
findings.evidence: The freeze marks validation exposure true and selection scope as 55 queries/12 documents. Its selected values are document_macro_iou 0.5943266314, mean_query_iou 0.4228039048, global_recall 0.9800973768, and global_precision 0.2465865819.
